hints.title: Deep Read-Only Proxy Guarding
hints.text: Protecting an object tree from mutations requires intercepting assignment, deletion, and mutating array methods across all nested levels.

hints.title: Recursive Proxy Interception on Property Access
hints.text: Wrap the object in a Proxy. The get trap wraps any nested object or array in a read-only Proxy. The set and deleteProperty traps throw an error specifying the modified key.

hints.title: Proxy Guard Blueprint
hints.text: Traps: set(target, prop) throws `Error: Cannot modify key: ${String(prop)}`. deleteProperty throws same. For array methods like pop, push, shift, unshift, splice, sort, reverse: return function that throws error.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Intercepts property accesses on the fly without upfront recursive traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Object.freeze is shallow and does not protect nested arrays or objects unless recursively applied.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Lazy proxy wrapping incurs overhead only on accessed branches.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly guarding both dictionary key writes and built-in array mutating methods.

solutions.approach: Deep Read-Only Proxy with Mutation Method Guarding
